customers.why: One row per customer keyed by CustomerID with segment and currency; transactions, transactions_1k and yearmonth point at it.

gasstations.why: One row per gas station keyed by GasStationID with chain, country and segment; the transaction tables point at it.

products.why: 591 product codes with a description only; transactions_1k is the only table with rows that points at it (transactions is empty), so it folds there.

transactions.why: Empty: the column names say card transactions, but there are no rows to place it from.

transactions_1k.why: One row per card purchase keyed by TransactionID, stamped with Date and Time; customer, station and product repeat.

yearmonth.why: Each customer's monthly consumption, keyed by CustomerID plus Date with 21 months over 383,282 rows.
